text:
maya: FYI I'm taking over the bridge for INC-2026-47, routing fallback triggered across us-east-1. leaving notes here for the night team

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INC-2026-47 — High error-rate on /v1/generate in us-east-1. Pager duty triggered. Severity: P2. Affected customers: 4 (high usage).

maya: timeline — alerts started ~1769901000, spikes to 5xxs and timeouts. Auto-fallback to smaller model pool attempted but failing for some sessions.

sam: what's current traffic split? are requests queuing?

maya: queue depth up to ~1200 reqs/min for the route. CPU on primary GPU nodes at 92%, memory fine. some nodes show long KV cache miss latencies.

leo: checking autoscaler logs — there was a failed scale-up event at 1769901067, kube failed to bind new pods due to quota in the tenant namespace.

tj: we hit a soft quota? which quota — nodes or GPUs?

leo: nodequota — provider returned 429 on create. error: "quota exceeded: requested 2 gpus, available 0". I raised with infra but they're slow atm.

maya: mitigation in progress: 1) switching route to fallback region (us-west-2) for non-sticky sessions; 2) enabling temporary rate-limit to 60rps for affected customers; 3) manual warm pool spin-up on dedicated nodes where possible.

sam: can you paste the runbook snippet for fallback routing?

maya: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/routing-fallback. key commands below:
```
# reroute non-sticky
redwood route update --route /v1/generate --regions us-east-1,us-west-2 --prefer-region us-west-2 --sticky false
# set per-customer limit
redwood auth update-quota --customer-id cust-776 --rps 60
```

leo: I pushed a temporary policy at 1769901305 to mark non-critical traffic as best-effort. telemetry shows 15% of requests are non-authenticated test clients; we're blackholing some test keys.

tj: customer-impact summary? which SLAs are in risk?

maya: impacted: 4 customers with high usage — two are degraded (>1000ms p95, some 5xx), two are partially falling back to cached responses. No total outage. We're at lowered SLO for latency for the route. I flagged SEC and support.

oncall-bot: Note: Support page updated for INC-2026-47 at 1769901400.

sam: any ongoing mitigations that the next shift must maintain?

maya: yes — checklist for handoff:
- Keep temporary rate-limits in place until quota is resolved
- Monitor autoscaler logs; if provider quota is fixed, trigger manual scale-up with `redwood infra scale --pool fallback-warm --count 4`
- Keep reroute until p95 latency in us-east-1 < 400ms for 10m
- If rebalancing completes, revert sticky sessions carefully to avoid session loss
- Contact infra slack channel (#eng-infra) and paste provider ticket id (I filed ticket #PROV-982)

leo: current mitigations in progress: warm-pool spin starting (2/4 up), reroute active, rate-limiting live. provider ticket escalated to on-call at cloud-vendor.

tj: coverage note — I'm primary until 1769902800, then leo takes primary and maya secondary. there's a gap from 1769902800-1769903100 where we're short-handed because of a timezone handoff; please ensure leo is reachable.

maya: I'll be reachable on phone for the first hour of handoff. leaving my pager open.

sam: logs — adding snippet of error pattern: `rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = failed to allocate kv cache for session_id=...` seen at 1769901182.

leo: suggestion: add temporary kv cache eviction policy for oversized sessions to free memory. can do via config flag: `runtime.kv.evict.threshold=0.75`. will schedule if autoscaler finishes.

maya: visible customer workarounds: two customers are using our dedicated fallback endpoints already, one has enabled cached responses via webhook. Support DM already sent to those accounts.

oncall-bot: Reminder: create post-incident note in /incidents/INC-2026-47 within 24h.

maya: Handoff summary (copy into ticket): active mitigations: reroute to us-west-2 (non-sticky), temp rate-limits set, warm pool spin-up 2/4, provider quota open ticket PROV-982. Next actions for oncoming: monitor p95, retry scale-up when provider confirms quota freed, maintain rate-limits, escalate to SRE manager if CPU stays >90% after 30m.

sam: thanks. I'll keep this thread updated with any changes. tagging leo and tj for next shift. :thumbsup:

leo: got it. will take primary at 1769902800, will post status update every 15m until resolved.

maya: handing off now. signing out in 10m for short break but available if paging.

sam: closing loop — current state at 1769904723: partial recovery in us-west-2, us-east-1 still degraded but with lower error-rate. continuing watch.
